data: What is the recall@k value of the purple triangle at k = 16?

The question asks for the recall@k value of the purple triangle at k = 16. From the caption, we know that the purple triangle represents the BM25 model. The x-axis represents the value of k, and the y-axis represents the recall@k value. At k = 16, the purple triangle is positioned above the 0.8 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the recall@k value of the purple triangle at k = 16 is approximately 0.8.
